metrics.verdict: 只是更爱拒答，不算价值

present.llm_free_text: Acute DIC with shock triggered by povidone-iodine instilled under pressure through the nephrostomy (pyelovenous backflow causing systemic iodine absorption, possibly with endotoxemia or bacteremia)

removed.llm_free_text: Acute DIC with shock after povidone-iodine was pushed under pressure into the renal pelvis and absorbed into the blood (iodine toxicity or an anaphylactoid reaction). The alternative is endotoxin release or bacteremia from the pressurized instillation, causing septic shock with DIC.

present.llm_free_text: Secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis triggered by visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar)

removed.llm_free_text: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), most likely secondary to visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar); primary/familial HLH or a TB/EBV trigger remain alternatives

present.llm_free_text: Pancreatic body ductal adenocarcinoma causing obstructive (tumor-associated) pancreatitis; main alternative is mass-forming focal autoimmune pancreatitis (IgG4-related)

removed.llm_free_text: Mild acute pancreatitis caused by a mass in the pancreatic body. The most likely causes are pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with upstream duct obstruction or focal (mass-forming) autoimmune pancreatitis; primary pancreatic lymphoma is less likely.

present.llm_free_text: Severe acute Q fever (Coxiella burnetii) with pneumonia, hepatitis, thrombocytopenia, AKI and shock, likely from aerosol exposure while handling a bandicoot carcass; the main alternative is melioidosis (Burkholderia pseudomallei) with a splenic abscess

removed.llm_free_text: Melioidosis (Burkholderia pseudomallei) with pneumonia, septic shock and splenic abscess; main alternatives are Q fever (Coxiella burnetii from bandicoot exposure) and leptospirosis

present.llm_free_text: Salicylate toxicity from chronic topical 2% salicylic acid on extensive barrier-impaired skin (possibly with added clove oil/eugenol hepatotoxicity), causing severe lactic/metabolic acidosis, coagulopathy and shock in a malnourished infant

removed.llm_free_text: Salicylate toxicity from chronic topical 2% salicylic acid applied to extensive eczematous or nutritional dermatitis, with possible hepatotoxicity from clove oil (eugenol) teething drops, causing severe metabolic acidosis, shock, encephalopathy, and profound coagulopathy (INR >9) resembling acute liver failure

present.llm_free_text: Secondary syphilis, nodular or malignant (lues maligna) type, possibly with undiagnosed HIV co-infection

removed.llm_free_text: Secondary syphilis, possibly nodular/malignant (lues maligna), likely with HIV coinfection; mpox in the setting of HIV is an alternative

removed.llm_free_text: Bacterial meningitis/meningoencephalitis with sepsis and raised intracranial pressure in an immunosuppressed pemphigus patient, likely seeded from infected blistering skin (e.g., S. aureus) or an opportunistic pathogen such as Listeria

present.llm_free_text: Shiga toxin-producing E. coli hemorrhagic colitis progressing to hemolytic uremic syndrome (differential: carboplatin/chemotherapy-induced thrombotic microangiopathy)
